The closed-neighborhood synchronous rule forces every remaining mate of a singly blue triangle with probability one one round later; the hub succeeds independently with p=(1+X)/(2m). The exact multinomial E/S/F transition and E[Xnext|state]=X+S+2Ep, E[Snext|state]=2Ep(1-p) were checked. A left Perron moment inequality for M=[[2,1],[1,0]] gives a subcritical-time completion bound; Bernoulli warmup, Chernoff-controlled two-component Perron growth and white-fraction contraction produce matching upper time to c m and O_P(loglog m) extinction. A star domination and geometric-block tail control give uniform integrability and the expectation limit. Exactly hub-only initial state, fixed independent attempts and m->infinity.
